job.purpose: [el1011-hbm-sfu idle1012] hfd_sfu lane cluster (contract: 16 lane clusters per quarter, die-placed): ot_su12_sfu SFUT 2 with the ref_tile sigmoid chain as hard child (E side, W-face pins), 2 delay-line SRAMs in the W column, 2,251 lane pins on the W face (1-track pitch, lane precedent). Class-1 fix (47,785 sinks -> lane ~15k + chain own tree) and class-3 (RSTPIPE reset tree).

benches.name: c12_campaign_exact
benches.cmd: python3 tools/hbm_su_c12.py campaign --gsh 1 --kimm 1 --denr 1 --dring 4 --sfut 2 --quick --only random --no-1024 --scratch {RUN}/bw --out {RUN}/bench_pos.json > {RUN}/bench_pos.log 2>&1; grep -E 'random N=' {RUN}/bench_pos.log; n=$(grep -c 'pass=True' {RUN}/bench_pos.log); ! grep -q 'pass=False' {RUN}/bench_pos.log && [ $n -ge 5 ] && echo SFU_EXACT_PASS
benches.note: random N16 x3 + N64 x2 vs golden; the vehicle stage needs python tokenizers (absent on the fleet), as in the GSH/KIMM bench

benches.name: c12_neg_ring3_read_late
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/negative_src && cp -a rtl tools {RUN}/negative_src/ && cd {RUN}/negative_src && sed -i 's/localparam integer JR = (j - 1 + N) % N;/localparam integer JR = (j - 2 + N) % N;/' rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_c12.sv && grep -q 'JR = (j - 2 + N)' rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_c12.sv && python3 tools/hbm_su_c12.py campaign --gsh 1 --kimm 1 --denr 1 --dring 4 --sfut 2 --quick --only random --no-1024 --scratch {RUN}/bwn --out {RUN}/bench_neg.json > {RUN}/bench_neg.log 2>&1; grep -E 'random N=' {RUN}/bench_neg.log; grep -q 'pass=False' {RUN}/bench_neg.log && echo SFU_NEG_DETECTED && exit 1; exit 0
benches.note: Negative source isolated explicitly; its mutation never touches the route source.

benches.name: c12_neg_sfut_exp_early
benches.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/negative_src && cp -a rtl tools {RUN}/negative_src/ && cd {RUN}/negative_src && sed -i 's/    always @(posedge clk) begin y_exp <= y_exp_c; y_div <= y_div_c; end/    always @(posedge clk) y_div <= y_div_c; always @(*) y_exp = y_exp_c;/' rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_vec_lane_c12.sv && grep -q 'always @(\*) y_exp = y_exp_c' rtl/hdc/v41x/ot_hdc_v41x_vec_lane_c12.sv && python3 tools/hbm_su_c12.py campaign --gsh 1 --kimm 1 --denr 1 --dring 4 --sfut 2 --quick --only random --no-1024 --scratch {RUN}/bwn --out {RUN}/bench_neg.json > {RUN}/bench_neg.log 2>&1; grep -E 'random N=' {RUN}/bench_neg.log; grep -q 'pass=False' {RUN}/bench_neg.log && echo SFU_NEG_DETECTED && exit 1; exit 0
benches.note: Negative source isolated explicitly; its mutation never touches the route source.
